findings.title: Completion opens deliberate renewed effort
findings.claim: The completion named by فَرَغْتَ becomes available space for a deliberately chosen undertaking, and فَٱنصَبْ gives that undertaking the cost of renewed toil.
findings.mechanism: The focus completion and re-engagement branches meet the preceding ease-with-hardship assurance and the following directed desire, changing relief from a terminal pause into the threshold of another purposeful effort.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the command as a cycle in which an opening makes the next effort possible, while the plain command to strive remains intact.
findings.containment: This adds a recurrent readiness relation to the ordinary reading of finishing one task and exerting oneself; it does not erase the live reading of one completed duty followed by another.

epistemic.reason: The channel evidence supplies the focus branches and pericope relation, while the cycle-level synthesis is an explicit discovery inference.
